slice.title: Transactional worktree and safe tool capsules

execution_plane_contracts.implementation_claim_requirement: Freshly pin the exact current contract revision and content hash before any ACPR-12 implementation claim.
Freshly pin the exact current contract revision and content hash before any ACPR-12 implementation claim.

authority.freshness_rule: This packet does not substitute for current authority. A future implementation claim must independently read, pin, and compare the then-current ACPR-10, ACPR-11, CAO-08D, and CAO-08E authority inputs.

claim_may_be_created_only_after: This architecture/preclaim packet has separate independent acceptance recorded by Root.
Fresh exact-read pins for all authority inputs are materialized and equal the inspected current bytes.
The future writer names exact repository-relative allowed paths, path operations, hotfiles, regression tests, and a lease within the active run window.
The generic claim helper successfully reserves, dispatches, and confirms the new writer claim.
future_writer_envelope.scope: A later writer may implement only the minimal ACPR-12 transactional worktree and safe tool-capsule behavior that is explicitly bound by its own accepted claim.
prohibited_inference: This packet does not select writer paths.
This packet does not reserve, dispatch, start, renew, release, or transfer a writer claim or lease.
This packet does not authorize edits to source, tests, roadmap state, run state, shared routers, or execution-plane contracts.

no_live_effects: No deployment, publication, commit, push, merge, release, notification, provider activation, worker or thread dispatch, host mutation, or external service action.
No migration, activation, deletion, or product-side persistence change.
non_live_boundaries.no_network: No network, provider, browser, RPC, webhook, package download, or remote API interaction.
non_live_boundaries.no_secrets: Do not read, emit, persist, derive, or transmit credentials, tokens, private source content, user data, or secrets.
non_live_boundaries.no_host_shell: A future implementation must not execute host shell commands, subprocesses, arbitrary tools, or user-provided commands. Tool capsules remain declarative and fail closed unless their own accepted contract explicitly permits a bounded local mechanism.
non_live_boundaries.documentation_effect: This file is local planning evidence only and has no runtime, routing, persistence, or authority effect.

minimal_behavior: Represent a transaction as an explicit, bounded local operation with exact input and output boundaries.
Require immutable/readable authority inputs before an operation is considered eligible.
Use a declared safe-tool capsule interface with an allowlisted, content-free result shape and fail-closed behavior for unsupported or ambiguous inputs.
Keep control-plane and product writer authority separate; no shared router mutation is implied.
fail_closed_conditions: Missing, stale, ambiguous, unreadable, or mismatched authority pin.
Unexpected target existence, path drift, baseline drift, hotfile overlap, claim-state mismatch, or lease expiry.
Any requested effect outside the future writer's exact allowed-path and no-live envelope.
Any request to invoke a host shell, network, provider, secret-bearing input, or external side effect.
stop_conditions: Stop before the first write if any pinned authority blob differs from the freshly read byte hash.
Stop before the first write if the claim manifest, path operation, baseline, or worktree status differs from the registered future claim.
Stop and return the packet to architecture/review if a focused test exposes a contract ambiguity or an implementation needs an unregistered path or effect.

required: Fresh authority readback with exact revision, content hash, and path for ACPR-10, ACPR-11, CAO-08D, and CAO-08E.
Successful fresh claim-helper reservation, dispatch, and confirm-start evidence for the exact future writer manifest.
Focused deterministic tests covering normal operation, stale/missing pin rejection, path/baseline drift rejection, unsupported capsule rejection, and zero external-effect behavior.
Scoped diff inspection proving only registered writer paths changed and no secret, network, shell, provider, host, or live-effect code path was introduced.
Independent review from a fresh context after candidate freeze, with explicit confirmation that this architecture's boundaries remain intact.
not_sufficient: A roadmap status string without current byte-level authority pins.
Passing tests without a matching registered claim and independent review.

independent_review.timing: After the future implementation candidate is frozen and before acceptance or roadmap-status mutation.
review_questions: Do exact current authority pins support every claimed behavior?
Are all changed paths and tests within the registered future writer manifest?
Does the implementation fail closed for every stale pin, path drift, baseline drift, unsupported capsule, and prohibited-effect case?
Is there any direct or indirect network, secret, host-shell, provider, deployment, or other live effect?

separate_acceptance.this_packet: Requires independent Root acceptance as architecture/preclaim evidence only.
separate_acceptance.future_implementation: Requires a separate claim, separate candidate verification, separate independent review, and separate Root acceptance. Acceptance of this packet grants none of those authorities.
